ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity white pixels localized in linear and punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear parallel bands on the right lobe; isolated white punctate spots on the left lobe; dominant black pigmentation across 85% of total visible area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 85 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile with multiple low-amplitude peaks and valleys along the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge displays smoother, continuous curvature with fewer discrete serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping from the notch to the distal tips, with a slight upward concavity near the terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the lower medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four prominent, nearly parallel high-intensity white linear tracks (rake marks) on the right lobe; several intersecting, thinner white linear marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring on the right fluke lobe; distinct notch/indentation on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: White leading-edge pigmentation spots visible on the superior boundary of the left lobe.
